source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of negative impacts (PDF 187).

items: Digital divide: dehi Pakistan mein internet aur aalaat kam hain, jis se taleem aur rozgar mein na-barabar mauqe.
Ghalat maloomat aur jhooti khabrein: COVID-19 mein virus aur vaccines ke baare mein ghalat daawe social media par phaile, jis se uljhan aur khauf hua, jo digital khwandagi ki zaroorat dikhata hai.

Privacy: bohat sa zaati data jama hota hai; munasib qawaneen ke baghair ghalat istemal ho sakta hai. Kitab NADRA se shehriyon ke data ke ikhraj ko mazboot data protection ki zaroorat ki misal kehti hai.

blocks.text: 'Internet in a Box' mansoobe offline taleemi wasail dete hain aur Pakistan ke baghair internet door daraz ilaqon tak digital taleem laye hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Afraad ghalat maloomat ka nuqsan kaise kam kar sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yaqeen ya share karne se pehle daawon ko motabar maakhaz se jaanchein, aur ghair tasdeeq shuda paigham aage na bhejein.

items: Manfi asraat: digital divide, ghalat maloomat, privacy ke khatre.
